common.noChanges: Nothing changed — no new version was created.
common.noCommands: No command is available to you in this state.
common.decisionNoneAvailable: No decision of the required type exists yet. Governance decisions are raised in the Committee Hub.
common.noControl: This centre documents readiness and transition work. It never controls devices, networks or power: changes happen in the approved operational systems and are recorded here with evidence.

overview.title: Day-1 & TSA Center
overview.subtitle: Site and service readiness, transition plans with the go/no-go decision, TSAs and their exits.
overview.coverageAll: Every Day-1 readiness area has at least one check.

checks.title: Readiness checks
checks.subtitle: Site and workstream Day-1 checklists: mandatory blockers, test history and specialist sign-off.

create.title: New readiness check
create.effect: Creates a check that starts non-waivable; waivability is a later specialist determination.
create.signoffHint: Only holders of this role (with the sign-off permission) can sign the check off.

instantiate.title: Add the template's Day-1 checklist
instantiate.effect: Creates the project template's default checks (all Day-1 areas) for the selected site. Existing template checks are kept — nothing is duplicated.

check.notDetermined: Not yet determined by a specialist

tests.title: Test history
tests.hint: Append-only: a failed test stays visible after a later pass. A passing test never signs the check off.

record.title: Record a test run
record.effect: Appends a test run to the history (never edited).
record.effectFail: A failed test sets the check to failed; a failed blocker blocks GO.

signoff.title: Specialist sign-off
signoff.effect: Only the assigned specialist role signs off, on active evidence, when the latest test did not fail.
signoff.sod: Separation of duties: the owner and whoever recorded the latest test or evidence cannot sign off.

determine.title: Criticality and waivability (specialist)
determine.effect: Records the criticality, waivability and waiver authority with a documented basis. Pending waiver approvals become stale.

reopen.title: Reopen the check
reopen.effect: Returns a passed / not-applicable / waived check to in progress; its history is kept.

edit.title: Edit check
edit.effect: Changes descriptive fields only — never the status, criticality, waivability or sign-off.

waivers.title: Waivers of this check
waivers.requestEffect: Creates a waiver request bound to this version of the check, for approval by the waiver authority.
waivers.nonWaivable: This check is not waivable: an exception can never override it. A request is refused and logged.
waivers.authority: Approval needs the {role} role (not the requester).

waivers.title: Readiness waivers
waivers.subtitle: Waivers of readiness checks: basis, impact, the specialist-set authority and the approval.

approve.title: Approve waiver of {code}
approve.effect: Marks the check waived with this waiver; a waived blocker no longer blocks GO while the waiver is effective.
approve.authorityHint: Only the holder of the waiver authority role — never the requester — can approve.

reject.title: Reject waiver of {code}
reject.effect: The waiver is rejected; the check stays unmet.

cutover.title: Cutover & go/no-go
cutover.subtitle: Transition plans: runbook, window, service impact, accountable owner, communications, testing, contingency/rollback and the go/no-go decision.

create.title: New cutover plan
create.effect: Creates a plan in planning. It can go to go/no-go only when every §7.4 element is documented.

prereq.title: Transition prerequisites (§7.4)
prereq.hint: Fail-closed: every element is required before a GO; anything not documented counts as missing.

go.title: GO evaluation (server)
go.allowed: GO is allowed: no open blocker and every prerequisite is documented.
go.blocked: GO is blocked. The server refuses a GO until the items below are cleared.

checks.title: Readiness checks gating this plan
checks.hint: A project-wide plan is gated by every check not bound to another plan; a site plan by its site's checks and the checks bound to it.
checks.empty: No readiness check gates this plan.

decision.title: Go/no-go decision (governance)
decision.hidden: A decision is linked but you cannot view it.
decision.ok: Final approval — can back a GO.
decision.linkEffect: Links a governance decision of type Day-1 go/no-go. Only a final approval can back a GO; the link itself approves nothing.

history.title: Decision history
history.hint: Every submission, decision and refused GO — with the blockers at that moment. Never edited.

rehearsal.title: Record rehearsal / testing
rehearsal.effect: Records the testing summary and marks the transition rehearsed.

comms.title: Record communications approval
comms.effect: Records the reference of the approval of the transition communications.

submit.title: Submit for go/no-go
submit.effect: Only possible with every §7.4 element documented. You will not be able to decide it yourself.

back.title: Return to planning
back.effect: The plan can be changed again; earlier decisions stay in the history.

decide.title: Record the go/no-go decision
decide.effect: A GO is re-evaluated by the server now: an open blocker or a missing prerequisite refuses it, and the refusal is recorded in the history.
decide.sod: The person who submitted the plan cannot decide it.

execute.title: Record the execution
execute.effect: Records that the transition was executed in the approved operational systems (reference it in the note). Nothing is executed from here.

rollback.title: Record the rollback
rollback.effect: Records that the contingency / rollback was invoked.

accept.title: Post-transition acceptance
accept.effect: Only the accountable owner, not the person who recorded the execution, accepts — on active acceptance evidence.

edit.title: Edit cutover plan
edit.effect: Only while planning or rehearsing; never changes the status or the decision.
edit.locked: The plan is locked in this state — return it to planning to change it.

tsa.title: TSA register
tsa.subtitle: Transitional services: owner, end date, replacement and exit. Reaching the end date is never an exit.

expiry.exit_acceptance_pending: Ended {days} day(s) ago — exit approval pending

create.title: Register a TSA service
create.effect: Creates the service as proposed. Approval needs a complete record and a final governance decision.

tsaDetail.endNotExit: Reaching the end date is not an exit: an unreplaced service becomes expired-unresolved and is escalated. Extensions need an approved decision; the exit needs accepted replacement evidence and an independent approver.
tsaDetail.milestonesEmpty: No exit milestone yet (required for approval).

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.hidden: An escalation exists; open the Committee Hub to view it.

transition.title: TSA state command
transition.effect: Applies an allowed state-machine command. Exit, extension and expiry have their own guarded commands.

approve.title: Approve TSA terms
approve.effect: Needs a complete record (owner, scope, dates, exit milestones, replacement) and a FINAL governance decision of type TSA approval/extension.

acceptReplacement.title: Accept the replacement service
acceptReplacement.effect: Needs active, non-conflicting acceptance evidence linked to this TSA (evidence panel below).

failure.title: Report a replacement failure
failure.effect: Withdraws any replacement acceptance and raises an escalation (decision requested) with continuity and extension options. Nothing is extended.
failure.done: Failure reported; an escalation was raised.

requestExtension.title: Request an extension
requestExtension.effect: Links the extension decision with the proposed end date and continuity plan. Nothing is extended until the decision is finally approved.
requestExtension.done: Extension requested — awaiting the approved decision.

recordExtension.title: Record the approved extension
recordExtension.effect: Applies the proposed end date ONLY if the linked decision is a final approval; otherwise the server refuses it.

requestExit.title: Request exit approval
requestExit.effect: Binds the request to this version of the TSA and to the accepted replacement evidence; a later change invalidates it.

approveExit.title: Approve the TSA exit
approveExit.effect: Accepts the exit on the accepted replacement evidence.
approveExit.sod: The TSA owner, the requester and the replacement acceptor cannot approve.

rejectExit.title: Reject the exit approval
rejectExit.effect: The request is rejected; the TSA stays in its current state.

edit.title: Edit TSA
edit.effect: Descriptive fields only. Dates of an approved TSA change only through an approved extension; the status never changes here.
